mapper.select: SELECT f.friendship_id AS friendshipId, f.requester_id AS requesterId, u.nickname AS nickname, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM friendships f INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.requester_id WHERE f.receiver_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT f.friendship_id AS friendshipId, f.receiver_id AS receiverId, u.nickname AS nickname, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM friendships f INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.receiver_id WHERE f.requester_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname FROM friendships f INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN f.requester_id = #{userId} THEN f.receiver_id ELSE f.requester_id END WHERE (f.requester_id = #{userId} OR f.receiver_id = #{userId}) AND f.status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY u.nickname ASC
